name: lead-claude
description: Experimental (2026-11-18, F120): Claude Opus 5.5 medium leads. It plans every request first, listing its acceptance cases (the implied ones too), and picks per task: grunt (Claude Haiku 5.5 low), worker (Haiku 5.5 high), senior (Claude Sonnet 5.5 high) or itself. While they build it waits; then it reviews the merged change in a copy where it runs commands, and accepts or adds follow-up tasks for whichever developer it chooses, itself included, at most twice. No separate tester: the lead's review is the review. The owner's idea: a cheap model deciding first on a hard task decides badly.
